<function name="GetContentType" parent="spawnmenu" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns the function to create an vgui element for a specified content type, previously defined by <page>spawnmenu.AddContentType</page>.

If a content type doesn't exist, a dummy function will be returned, and a warning printed to the console.

You probably want to use <page>spawnmenu.CreateContentIcon</page> to create icons.
</description>

	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="function">The panel creation function.

<callback>
<arg type="Panel" name="container">The container panel to parent the created icon to.</arg>

<ret type="Panel" name="pnl">The created panel</ret>
</callback>
</ret>

</function>
